title: Support Topology and Gradient Mixing in Sinkhorn Layers
abstract: arXiv:2609.07954v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Sparse Sinkhorn layers use a fixed support graph to restrict transport between tokens. How does this graph control gradient propagation through the scaling iterations. We develop a fixed-support calculus showing that each row-column cycle induces a row-stochastic operator on column-potential perturbations modulo constants. Its transpose propagates zero-mass reverse-mode cotangents. The finite-cycle operator uses two distinct half-step transport plans; at a balanced fixed point it reduces to a two-step walk determined by a single plan. We derive the accompanying score and marginal source terms and use Dobrushin contraction and minorization to bound homogeneous and source-driven tail cotangents. Our main result characterizes when support and marginals guarantee one-step contraction uniformly over finite scores: every feasible face of the transportation polytope must have pairwise two-hop column overlap. Otherwise, suitable score directions

translated_title: Sinkhorn层中的支撑拓扑与梯度混合
translated_abstract: 稀疏Sinkhorn层使用固定的支撑图来限制token之间的传输。该图如何控制缩放迭代中的梯度传播？我们发展了一套固定支撑演算，证明在模常数意义下，每个行-列循环会对列势扰动诱导出一个行随机算子。其转置用于传播零质量的反向模式余切。有限循环算子使用两个不同的半步传输计划；在平衡不动点处，它退化为由单一计划确定的两步游走。我们推导了相应的得分项和边际源项，并利用Dobrushin收缩与minorization方法来界定齐次和源驱动的尾部余切。我们的主要结果刻画了支撑和边际在有限得分上一致保证一步收缩的条件：传输多面体的每个可行面必须具有成对的两跳列重叠。否则，某些合适的得分方向（原文此处截断）……
tldr: 本文发展了一套固定支撑演算来分析Sinkhorn层中的梯度传播机制，并证明了传输多面体的每个可行面具有成对两跳列重叠是支撑图与边际保证梯度均匀一步收缩的充要条件。
en_tdlr: This paper develops a fixed-support calculus for gradient propagation in Sinkhorn layers and proves that uniform one-step contraction of cotangents is guaranteed by support and marginals if and only if every feasible face of the transportation polytope has pairwise two-hop column overlap.
